tools.name: about_orangeride
tools.description: Facts about OrangeRide: area covered, booking notice, payment, Gatwick meeting points, flight tracking, contact details.

tools.name: find_place
tools.description: Look up a UK pickup or drop-off place (street address, postcode, station, hotel). Returns up to 5 matches with ids for get_quote. Not for Gatwick Airport: use the ids gatwick_north or gatwick_south.

tools.name: check_flight
tools.description: Check a flight landing at Gatwick: airline, origin, scheduled landing (UK time) and terminal. Use for pickups from Gatwick.

tools.name: suggest_pickup_time
tools.description: For a trip to Gatwick to catch a flight: works out the pickup time (at the airport 2 hours before the flight, plus the drive and 10 minutes spare).

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Fixed fare for a trip. With date, time, passengers and suitcases: the exact fare and a quote_id for booking (valid 30 minutes). Without date and time: a typical daytime 'from' price only.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Start a booking request for a quote the user has agreed to. Texts a 6-digit code to the user's mobile; then ask the user for it and call confirm_booking. Only after reading the trip and fare back to the user.

tools.name: confirm_booking
tools.description: Send the booking request with the code the user received by text. Returns a reference. It is a REQUEST: OrangeRide texts the user to confirm it.

tools.name: booking_status
tools.description: Status of one OrangeRide booking. Needs the reference and the mobile number it was booked with.
